# Michaels Sheet Metal

> Michaels Sheet Metal provides comprehensive sheet metal fabrication, metal roofing, rain gutter, and waterproofing services for residential and commercial properties throughout Los Angeles and Southern California.

Based in the Los Angeles area, Michaels Sheet Metal specializes in custom sheet metal work including standing seam metal roofs, rain gutters in copper and other materials, architectural cladding, HVAC systems, and waterproofing solutions. The company serves clients across Los Angeles County and Southern California with both residential and commercial projects.

## Key Topics

- Metal Roofing
- Rain Gutters
- Sheet Metal Fabrication
- Standing Seam Roofs
- Copper Gutters
- ACM Wall Panels
- Waterproofing
- HVAC Ducts
- Architectural Sheet Metal
- Gutter Installation
- Los Angeles
- Residential Roofing
- Commercial Roofing
- Metal Materials (copper, zinc, stainless steel, galvanized steel)
- Water Damage Prevention
